line_items.reasoning: Pricing actions delivered only 140–170 bps in Q2 vs. the guided 3%–4% (300–400 bps) exit-rate target, reflecting material timing slippage due to tariff pauses and policy changes.
No updated capex figures were reported that deviate from the full-year $265M–$285M guidance; the range appears on track with no indication of over- or under-spend.

Operating margin reached 21% (+80 bps YoY) with incremental margins exactly at 30%, demonstrating strong gross margin defense in Q2, though management flagged price/cost headwinds becoming more challenging in H2 2025.

Q2 revenue exceeded $2 billion for the first time in company history with 8.6% growth — the strongest daily sales rate since Q1 2023 — clearly outperforming the cautious, no-formal-guidance stance management communicated amid limited visibility and trade policy uncertainty.
